name: wrap
description: Delegate a prompt to a subagent and return only the distilled answer, flagging what looks wrong.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate a prompt, get back only the core insight
interface.longDescription: Interprets a rambling or voice-dictated prompt, runs the work in an isolated subagent, and returns a distilled high-altitude answer instead of a long report. Flags claims that look overclaimed or wrong, and checks the doubtful ones in the background.
defaultPrompt: Wrap this: work out why the p99 latency is spiking.
Use the wrap on it and keep it high level.
Wrap that prompt and tell me if anything looks off.
